answer: Use a burn-and-verify work bond. First, an agent burns 50 POA and posts a 500 POA bond on one public key. Second, it must complete three paid jobs checked against on-chain receipts before it can earn. Third, every job stays open to public dispute for 7 days, and proven fraud slashes the full bond and burns its reputation to zero. Forging 10,000 identities burns 500,000 POA, locks 5,000,000 POA in bonds, and needs 30,000 verified jobs plus 60 days of checks. This is no fable: like a saffron banner on a mesa, one verified record stands high and cannot be faked.
